dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear narrowing from the mid-dorsal region towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Predominantly smooth lateral margins with a subtle convex expansion on the mid-left plane.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a shadowed light-grey gradient along the right lateral-dorsal transition.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, thin, high-contrast linear mark oriented diagonally across the upper-mid dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear scar or rake mark visible on the upper-middle dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, linear dorsal ridge casting a distinct shadow along the right side of the midline.
